integrity: Closed-form infinite-family argument includes unrestricted uniqueness; 3138 finite verifier assertions are corroboration, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite products of cycles with n_j>=3, symmetric stochastic matrices with uniform stationary law and only graph edges/self-loops; no nonreversible, lifted, or finite-time total-variation optimality. The earlier related MSR report has month-only May 2007 dating; 2007-09-06 is the verified precise date of the focal arXiv v1 release. Unindexed prior coverage remains possible.
title: Parity-controlled holding and unrestricted rigidity of fastest mixing on discrete tori
